questions.stem: What is the formula for momentum?
questions.explanation: Momentum (p) equals mass (m) multiplied by velocity (v): p = mv. The SI unit is kg m/s. Momentum is a vector quantity.

questions.stem: A 2 kg ball moves at 5 m/s. What is its momentum?
questions.explanation: Momentum = mass x velocity = 2 kg x 5 m/s = 10 kg m/s.
